Their full executable source is packaged, and each check was replayed.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric network. The result answers the natural monitoring question of how to relocate minimum PMUs without ever losing observation capability: all minima remain connected even under edge-local slides, but a sharp five-extra-move cost occurs for 486 pairs, and one 54-state orbit minimizes worst-case sliding distance. This precise optimization metric is nontrivial and supplies a complete reproducible benchmark; it is not inferred from the known graph identity or a bare optimizer count.
